summary.text: David Nelson is the Democratic candidate for Oregon House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Dan Farrington in a race with no incumbent.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary with 96.8 percent of the vote.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, David Nelson described himself as a concerned citizen who noticed that the position was not represented by a Democrat and said people need a choice.
He listed his key messages as affordable health care for everyone and the reality of climate change, and named elder care as a policy area he is passionate about.
